# prime-datepicker

prime-rs: DatePicker component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/datepicker) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-datepicker) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/datepicker.md)

DatePicker - port of PrimeNG 21.1.10 `p-datepicker` (stage 1).

Selecting a date, several dates, or a range in a calendar: an input with an overlay panel or an inline calendar,
"days", "months", "years" views, constraints, disabled dates, formats and "Today"/"Clear" buttons. The calendar
logic is pure (`calendar`). Time and keyboard navigation across cells are stage 2.

```rust
#![recursion_limit = "512"]
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_datepicker::{DatePicker, calendar::CalDate};

let value = RwSignal::new(vec![CalDate::new(2026, 10, 5)]);
let html = view! { <DatePicker value=value /> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-datepicker-input") && html.contains("11/05/2026"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-datepicker = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["datepicker"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
